HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Hard dutch: Kangrim at the wind-stripped edge of Tubo's ice roof path, face thinner, fist just finished a single hard blow; a caravan man reels midground. LEFT sheet = mortal Kangrim face (drawn gaunt, not portrait-fat); RIGHT = Tubo rite board for snow ridges, prayer flags as colour only — ignore board faces. ONE device: a white wind-blade diagonal across the frame. First violence. Day high-key blown snow. Hex #4a4a58 in cold specular on salt bag. No text. No watermark.
